title: Golden workbook (gt_04_golden.xlsx) leaves multiple objective formula and cell-reference bugs unfixed in graded ranges, penalizing valid fixes
evidence:
The sole verifier `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (`verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells`, weight `1.0`) grades `answer_position` across all 13 sheets against `gt_04_golden.xlsx`, requiring 100% match on modification cells and >=99.8% match on regression cells. Comparing `untouched_input_Relative vs Absolute References_input.xlsx` to `gt_04_golden.xlsx` shows that the golden workbook only fixes 4 dragged relative-reference rows (`DCF!C22:G22` locking `$C$8`, `LBO Analysis!E9:I9` locking `'Sources & Uses'!$I15`, `LBO Analysis!E41:I41` locking `*$D41`, and `LBO Analysis!E42:I42` locking `*$D42`), while leaving numerous objective broken references and column-shift bugs inside the graded ranges untouched:
1. `Income Statement!J26:N26` & `PP&E, Debt, NWC!D65:H66`: In `PP&E, Debt, NWC`, the Existing Indebtedness (`D55:H61`) and New Debt (`L55:P61`) schedules cover Period 1-5 (`2021-2025`), so `D73:H73` (`=D61+L61`..`=H61+P61`) holds 2021-2025 Total Interest Expense (`163.37`, `108.24`, `97.64`, `92.00`, `90.62`). Consequently, `gt_04_golden.xlsx` puts 2022 interest (`-108.243085614738`) into 2021 (`J26`) and references an empty cell (`I73`) for 2025 (`N26=0`), which also triggers `#DIV/0!` in `Line Item Metrics!M29` (`=M28/-'Income Statement'!N26`).
2. `PP&E, Debt, NWC!C81:M83`: In the Operating Working Capital schedule (`C79:M84`, years `2015-2025`), row 80 (`Accounts Receivable`, `C80:M80`) references `'Balance Sheet'!D15:N15` (`2015-2025`), but rows 81-83 (`Inventory`, `Accounts Payable`, `Accrued Expenses`, `C81:M83`) are shifted one column left to `'Balance Sheet'!C17:M17`, `C29:M29`, and `C30:M30` (`2014-2024`), corrupting `DCF!C19:G20` (NWC changes and FCF), `DCF!C32` (`57.968341030264` instead of `58.592701413954`), `Summary!H12:H13`, and the LBO cash flow sweep.

title: SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check: verify_spreadsheetbench2_cells fails all three attempts (score 0.0) because its golden file retains broken cell references that the agents properly fixed
evidence:
Across all 3 units, `SpreadsheetBench 2 official cell check` (weight `1.0`) returned `score=0` (`unit 1: regression 0.9741, modification 0.1170, 223 cell errors`; `unit 2: regression 0.9736, modification 0.2234, 216 cell errors`; `unit 3: regression 0.9741, modification 0.2234, 213 cell errors`).
Reconstructing the agents' edits from the trajectories and verifier error messages shows that all 3 units found and fixed the 4 intended relative-to-absolute reference bugs (`DCF!C22:G22`, `LBO Analysis!E9:I9`, `LBO Analysis!E41:I41`, `LBO Analysis!E42:I42`), and also fixed genuine 1-column shift errors that were left broken in `gt_04_golden.xlsx`:
- Fixing `PP&E, Debt, NWC!C81:M83` (where Inventory, Accounts Payable, and Accrued Expenses for 2015-2025 referenced 2014-2024 `Balance Sheet!C17:M30` instead of `D17:N30`) changes 2021-2025 NWC and Free Cash Flow, yielding `Summary!H12 = 58.592701413954` and `Summary!H13 = 0.253319816341263` (exact match to Unit 2 and Unit 3 outputs, which the verifier flagged as Modification errors against the unfixed golden values `57.968341030264` and `0.239964514016342`).
- Fixing `Income Statement!J26:N26` (where 2021-2025 Interest Expense referenced `-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!E73:I73` — 2022-2025 plus blank `I73` — instead of 2021-2025 `-'PP&E, Debt, NWC'!D73:H73`) along with the NWC fix yields 2021 Interest Expense `Income Statement!J26 = -161.996818046479` and EBT `Income Statement!J28 = 16.5981708761683` (exact match to Unit 1, Unit 2, and Unit 3 outputs, which the verifier flagged as Modification errors against the golden workbook's shifted 2022 interest `-108.243085614738` and EBT `70.3519033079092`).
Thus the verifier falsely rejects valid, thorough model fixes in every unit.
